limitations: Original R7 stays invalid for attribution; its integration deltas are descriptive and never requalified.
One independent Chromium per triage; six ABC cycles are repeated sessions inside that browser, not six independent experiments.
Historical R6 plaintext hashes differ from the previously authorized R7 corpus. R2 reuses exact R7 bytes, without regeneration.
Service/component demand-driven buffering consumes fewer chunks than control during the same playback window. Equal corpus does not mean equal bytes processed.
Control/service are muted; the unchanged player is unmuted, with original 500ms canplay interval. Same autoplay launch flag for all.
Common Angular/crypto startup precedes stable baseline. Control Blob workers and real-service URL workers belong to different composite boundaries.
Known ownership counters do not measure all native memory, GPU/VRAM or listener retention and do not establish absence of leaks.

Measurement native counters are cumulative per ABC cycle. Per-fixture playback counters are observed; per-fixture native SB counts are verified before freeze in the real integrated test, not inferred from measured totals.
No individual cause, confirmed leak, security defect, universal bound or absence of growth is established.
